name: Seville
label: Preview: not fully supported
caveat: This is a preview: ODYS doesn't plan days, journeys or bookings here yet. Please don't rely on it alone: check each place's own site on the day for hours, prices and bookings.

emergency.line: 112: ambulance, fire and police. Free from landlines and mobiles.

places.name: Real Alcázar de Sevilla
places.title: Palace courtyards and gardens of the Royal Alcázar
places.hours: 1 Oct-31 Mar daily 09:30-17:00 (clearing from 17:45); 1 Apr-30 Sep 09:30-19:00; closed 1 and 6 Jan, Good Friday and 25 Dec
notices: The shops are temporarily without service (reopening to be announced)

places.name: Catedral de Sevilla y la Giralda
places.title: The cathedral, then up the Giralda's ramps for the view
places.hours: Mon-Sat 10:45-18:00 (box office closes 17:00); Sun 14:30-19:00 (box office closes 18:00); may change for services
notices: Only the Giralda climb and the Fons Pietatis exhibition (Congreso Internacional de Hermandades) (4 Dec 2026 to 7 Dec 2026)
Closed to the cultural visit (8 Dec 2026)

places.name: Museo de Bellas Artes de Sevilla
places.title: Murillo and Zurbarán in a former convent
places.hours: Tue-Sat 09:00-21:00; Sundays and holidays 09:00-15:00; closed Mondays; August Tue-Sun 09:00-15:00

places.name: Casa de Pilatos
places.title: Tiles, patios and gardens in a Seville palace
places.hours: Every day 09:00-18:00

places.name: Palacio de las Dueñas
places.title: The Alba family's palace and its orange-tree patios
places.hours: Winter (October-March) 10:00-18:00, access and box office close 17:15; summer (April-September) 10:00-19:00; closed 1 and 6 Jan and 25 Dec; may close in winds over 50 km/h
notices: May close fully or partly on days with wind over 50 km/h

places.name: Palacio de la Condesa de Lebrija
places.title: A palace floored with Roman mosaics
places.hours: Open every day; September-June 10:00-18:00, July-August 10:00-15:00; last entry 45 minutes before closing

places.name: Museo del Baile Flamenco
places.title: Flamenco's story over four floors, with an evening show
places.hours: 10:00-18:45, last entry 18:00; the first Monday of each month opens at 14:30; shows at 17:00, 19:00 and 20:45

places.name: Centro Andaluz de Arte Contemporáneo (CAAC)
places.title: Contemporary art in a monastery on La Cartuja
places.hours: Tue-Sat 10:00-20:00; Sundays and holidays 10:00-15:30; closed Mondays and 1, 6 Jan, 3 Apr, 1 May, 15 Aug, 24, 25, 31 Dec (2026)

places.name: Archivo General de Indias
places.title: The archive of Spain's empire in the old exchange
places.hours: Tue-Sat 09:30-17:00; Sundays and holidays 10:00-14:00; closed Mondays; last entry 30 minutes before closing (the city's June 2025 leaflet)

places.name: Museo de Artes y Costumbres Populares
places.title: Andalusian crafts and costume in a 1929 pavilion
places.hours: Tue-Sat 09:00-21:00; Sundays and holidays 09:00-15:00; closed Mondays; summer (16 Jun-15 Sep) Tue-Sun 09:00-15:00 (the city's June 2025 leaflet)

places.name: Plaza de España
places.title: The 1929 Plaza de España, its canal and tiled alcoves
places.hours: Winter (November-March) 08:00-22:00; summer (April-October) 08:00-24:00 (the city's June 2025 leaflet)
notices: If María Luisa Park closes for the weather, the plaza is reached from Avenida de Portugal by the Aragón and Navarra gates: 'Este acceso no es accesible en silla de ruedas'

places.name: Setas de Sevilla (Metropol Parasol)
places.title: Walk the wooden canopy's rooftop path at dusk
places.hours: Open daily from 09:30; in winter it closes at 00:00 (summer 01:00); last admission 30 minutes before closing. The Aurora light show starts about 18:00 in winter
notices: The two pages disagree on cancellation (24 hours, or 2 hours, before the visit)

places.name: Parque de María Luisa
places.title: Shade, fountains and pavilions in María Luisa Park
places.hours: Every day 08:00-24:00 ('todos los días de 8:00 a 24:oo horas')

places.name: Barrio de Triana
places.title: Across the bridge to Triana's streets and ceramics
places.hours: Public streets. The neighbours' patios are private: 'no todos son visitables, se pueden admirar desde fuera'

places.name: Mercado de Triana
places.title: Triana's market by the bridge: stalls, tapas bars and a cookery school
places.hours: Mon-Sat 09:00-15:00 (the stalls); some stalls open on other days and hours; bars and the cookery class keep their own hours, not stated
notices: Stall hours vary: 'algunos abren días y horas diferentes'

places.name: Mercado de Feria
places.title: The old Calle Feria market and its bars
places.hours: Mon-Sat 08:00-15:00 (stalls); the bars inside ('El Cafelito del Mercado', 'Jaleo Guadalquibeer & Tapas', 'La Cantina de Feria') keep their own hours, not stated

places.name: Mercado de la Encarnación
places.title: The market under the Setas, for a morning snack

places.name: Mercado del Arenal
places.title: A working 1947 market in El Arenal

places.name: Arte y Sabor
places.title: Spanish, Moroccan and fusion plates on the Alameda
places.hours: Every day 13:30-23:30 ('Todos los días - 13:30 a 23:30', printed with the Alameda restaurant)

places.name: Casa Robles
places.title: A classic Andalusian restaurant by the cathedral
places.hours: Monday to Sunday 12:30-24:00

airport: Bus: Línea EA 'Especial Aeropuerto' (TUSSAM). To Seville 4:30-00:05; to the airport 5:22-1:00. Single 6 €, return 8 €; card payment on board ('pagar directamente en el autobús mediante tarjeta bancaria')
Taxi: Fixed airport fares: 'Tarifa 4: 26 €' Mon-Fri 7:00-21:00; 'Tarifa 5: 29 €' other times, weekends and holidays; 0,57 € per bag over 10 kg (max four)
not_covered: City buses, metro and journey times: the operators' pages couldn't be read, so none are given.
